stories.title: US offers up to $20 million for tips on Iran's nuclear programme
stories.summary: The U.S. State Department announced a Rewards for Justice bounty of up to $20 million for information on Iran’s nuclear programme and said the person providing the intelligence could be offered relocation assistance. The offer follows former President Donald Trump’s claim that a 2023 U.S.-Israel bombing campaign had completely destroyed Iran’s nuclear facilities, a claim Iran rejects, insisting its programme is peaceful. The U.S. military said it is forming a task force to curb Iran’s movement of weapons and sanctioned material across its borders.
stories.why: The reward aims to encourage intelligence that could help the United States and partners impede Iran’s potential nuclear weapons development.

stories.title: What we know so far after Krakow gun attack
stories.summary: At least six people were killed and more than a dozen others injured when a gunman suspected to have ties to the far-right opened fire in central Krakow, the second largest city in Poland. The attack began shortly before 15:00 local time (14:00 GMT) in Krakow's Main Market Square, the bustling central point of the city which is popular with tourists.

stories.previousSummary: At least six people were killed and several others injured when a gunman, suspected of far‑right ties, drove into Krakow’s Main Market Square shortly before 15:00 local time and opened fire from his vehicle. stories.title: Diwali 2025 winners: 8 BSE 500 stocks more than doubled
stories.summary: Eight stocks in the BSE 500 posted gains exceeding 100% since Diwali 2025, with some rising as much as 191%, according to ACE Equities data. During the same period, the broader Nifty 50 declined nearly 3%, while 190 index constituents posted positive returns overall. The outperforming group stood out even as most of the index moved sideways or lower.
stories.why: Highlights rare index outperformance in a broadly mixed market.
